node.statement: For p>=0 and n=p+q>=0, E^{p,q}=(I^p intersect A^n)/(I^{p+1} intersect A^n). The preceding preservation and associated-graded calculation show that sigma^* preserves F^{p,q} and acts on E^{p,q} by (-1)^p; if E^{p,q} is nonzero, exterior-length parity gives (-1)^p=(-1)^n=(-1)^(p+q), while on a zero component the asserted scalar action is automatic. This proves the contract.
